    • Director: Krishnakumar Ramakumar | Screenplay: R. Madhavan, Krishnakumar Ramakumar | Music: Govind Vasantha | Producers: Varghese Moolan, Vijay Moolan, Sarita Madhavan, R. Madhavan

    Summary: G.D.N (G.D. Naidu: The Edison of India) is a 2026 Indian Tamil-language biographical drama film chronicling the remarkable life, engineering breakthroughs, and industrial triumphs of Gopalswamy Doraiswamy (G.D.) Naidu. Directed by Krishnakumar Ramakumar and starring R. Madhavan alongside Priyamani, Sathyaraj, Jayaram, and Dushara Vijayan, the film captures the relentless ingenuity of India's foremost self-taught inventor against bureaucratic adversity and colonial resistance.

    Plot

    Spanning from the early 1920s to the 1950s in Coimbatore and across international research centers, the film chronicles the extraordinary life of G.D. Naidu (R. Madhavan), a self-taught engineering genius from rural Tamil Nadu who went on to create India's first indigenous electric motor, mechanical voting machines, revolutionary agricultural hybrids, and advanced razor blades. Despite continuous roadblocks from colonial authorities, corporate skepticism, and institutional tax disputes, Naidu remained committed to democratizing industrial innovation and affordable transport for everyday citizens. His unwavering conviction, scientific acumen, and fierce philanthropic spirit cementing his immortal legacy as 'The Edison of India'.
